description: This file provides an in-memory implementation of the ProfileDao interface for managing ProfileEntity objects. It supports operations such as inserting, deleting, fetching profiles, and observing profile list changes as a Flow. It is intended as a fallback when Room initialization fails.

classes.name: InMemoryProfileDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ProfileDao, managing ProfileEntity instances with lifecycle-aware state flow and CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow of the list of all profiles, observed as a cold stream.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a ProfileEntity into memory, assigning an ID if necessary, and returns the assigned ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified ProfileEntity by its ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a profile by its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProfileEntity by ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the in-memory profiles list and ID counter.
